title: Parent-packet review retention: explicit-read canonical parent, bounded retry on persistent failure, terminal-gate boundaries
outcome:
Three of the follow-up Lows from w-b18b11972c44's review rounds are resolved; the other two are ruled by Fable2 (03723eab #5690).
(1) get_delegation_result_selected resolves the canonical parent once, for both branches, so a whitespace-padded parent can neither write custody under the padded id nor miss the parent check on the result-id branch.
(2) The packet path's terminal gate has behavioural tests for its boundaries.
(3) A terminal reviewer whose retention keeps failing is retried at most once per change of its delegation record, not on every packet poll.
Ruled: the follow-up race is split into w-19d15da254a8; HEAD publishing is accepted behaviour (axum serves HEAD through the GET handler, the publication is idempotent, and TermAl has no HEAD caller).
acceptance: An explicit attempt-only read with a whitespace-padded parent id writes custody only under the canonical parent; a later canonical read and follow-up retention succeed; and the result-id branch also resolves the padded parent as the parent. The canonical parent is resolved once at the top of get_delegation_result_selected, for both branches. Shown by a behavioural test.
The packet path's terminal gate is covered by behavioural tests for a Failed attempt, a non-current attempt and storage disabled.

Repeated parent packet reads of a terminal reviewer whose retention fails persistently do not run a full retention or capture on every read: a failed retention is not retried on every poll; it is retried once per record change; overlapping reads may each attempt once. The failure is remembered per (delegation, attempt, the record's status or updated identity), and the remembered retainedReviewAttemptsError is served until that identity changes. The bound is documented in docs/features/review-attempt-retention.md. Shown by a behavioural test with deterministic capture counts, not timing.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary: Landed as 915cfd56 on master: parent-packet review retention. get_delegation_result_selected resolves the canonical parent once, for both branches, so a padded parent can neither write custody under the padded id nor skip the parent check. Behavioural tests cover the packet path's terminal gate for a Failed attempt, a non-current attempt and storage disabled. A persistently failing retention is remembered per (parent, delegation, attempt) against the record's status, completion and current-attempt identity. It is retried once per record change; overlapping reads may each attempt once; and a stale writer never removes a newer read's failure. The bound is documented in docs/features/review-attempt-retention.md. Review pair 3 was clean; the full gate passed on the exact tree (test-5a7759bc); the post-landing evaluation passed all four criteria.
